test_iterate_in_subprocess_basic: test iterate_in_subprocess by running a generator function in a subprocess and verifying output matches expected range
test_iterate_in_subprocess_initializer: test iterate_in_subprocess with an initializer function that writes to a file before iteration starts
test_iterate_in_subprocess_buffer_size: test iterate_in_subprocess with buffer_size=1 to verify interactive item-by-item iteration from subprocess
test_execute_iterable_failure_handling: test _execute_iterable to verify initializer failures and iterator failures are reported with correct status codes
test_iterate_in_subprocess_timeout: test iterate_in_subprocess timeout behavior when the worker subprocess does not produce data within the timeout period
